facts.value: The university offers a variety of activities, including numerous sports courses, cultural offerings such as the Movie Club (shooting and presenting films), the English Speaking Society, as well as musical, theatrical, and hobby clubs where students can engage creatively and communally.
Approximately 9% of students, which corresponds to about 1,209 international students, come from abroad.
Over 70% of courses are taught in small groups of a maximum of 40 students.

Students regularly organize a diverse program of performances, food stalls, live music, and cultural contributions, open to everyone on campus, especially during events like the Kodaira Festival or Ikkyosai.
The university offers over 150 clubs and 'Circles', including sports clubs, music and theater groups, as well as academic and research-related initiatives.
The Circles are particularly noted for their openness to international students and provide a great opportunity to make contacts and participate actively in campus life.
